result.topic_en: Notes on the set of discontinuity points of a function (countability, possible configurations), the question of when dy/dx = f(x) has an integral, and remarks on one-to-one mappings of a line onto a plane.

items.quote:
Die Punktmenge der Unstetigkeitsstellen muss nothwendig
dann eine abzählbare sein;
items.english: The point set of the points of discontinuity must then necessarily be a countable one;

items.quote:
Daher ist nicht
möglich: [-x-] an allen rationalen Stellen stetig
an allen übrigen unstetig.
items.english: Hence it is not possible: continuous at all rational points, discontinuous at all the others.

items.english: If dy/dx is an arbitrary real function of the real variable x, when does the differential equation dy/dx = f(x) have an integral?
